About Us



We are a growing UK-based Mechanical and Electrical Building Services Consultancy, delivering innovative engineering solutions across a range of sectors including commercial, hospitality, food & drink, industrial, distilleries, healthcare and education.



We are looking for an enthusiastic and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help expand our client base by identifying opportunities, generating leads and booking meetings for our senior management team.



This is a remote role with long-term career potential for the right candidate.



Key Responsibilities



* Research and identify potential clients across the UK.

* Build targeted prospect lists including:



  * Architects

  * Project Managers

  * Main Contractors

  * Property Developers

  * Distilleries

  * Hotels

* Conduct outbound prospecting via:

* Book discovery meetings and appointments for the Managing Director.

* Maintain accurate records within the CRM system.

* Follow up previous enquiries and dormant contacts.

* Monitor planning applications and construction news for potential projects.

* Keep prospect databases clean and up to date.

* Assist with LinkedIn outreach campaigns and networking follow-ups.

Required Skills

* Confident communicating with senior professionals.

* Build a high-quality database of target prospects.

* Launch consistent outbound outreach campaigns.

title: PR & Media Outreach Specialist (AI-Native, Full-Time)
description:
Company: Undisclosed, an AI-native creative, media & technology company

Type: Full-time

Schedule: Must overlap with European (CET) working hours, details below

Reports to: Founder



---



ABOUT US

We're an AI-native company building at the intersection of technology, entertainment, and brand-building. We move fast, we build AI systems that are embedded in everything we do, and we're launching several high-profile projects over the next year. You'll work directly with the founder to put his story, and the brands he's building, in front of major media: podcasts, journalists, publications, and YouTube channels.



This is a rare ground-floor role. The founder has decades of untold stories (including time spent learning from one of the most legendary people in the entertainment industry of all time) and a portfolio of tech startups with real traction. Your job is to help the world find out about it.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

You are the engine room of our media outreach. Every day, you'll be researching journalists and shows, drafting pitches, sending outreach to smaller outlets, following up relentlessly, tracking everything, and turning our podcast/video appearances into short clips. You'll prepare the big pitches for the founder to send himself, and some where you represent him and the brands under the company.



This is high-volume, detail-heavy execution work. If you love the satisfaction of a well-organized pipeline, landing placements, and seeing your work create real 
ntum, you'll thrive. If you want a slow, passive admin job, this isn't it.



Important: We are an AI-native company. You do NOT need to be an AI expert today, but you must be genuinely excited to learn. We'll train you to use AI tools (like Claude and others) to do the work of a team of people. You need to be technically open, curious, and unafraid of new software.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Daily:

- Monitor journalist-request platforms (Qwoted, 
, Source of Sources) and X/Twitter for relevant media opportunities, and flag the best ones

- Rewrite and prepare articles and posts generated by our systems that will go out on social media and web (LinkedIn, X, etc)

- Draft pitch responses and cold pitches in the founder's voice (we'll give you templates and examples)

- Send high-volume outreach to smaller/niche outlets and podcasts directly

- Keep the media tracker meticulously updated (outlet, contact, angle, status, follow-up dates)



Weekly:

- Send 10–15 personalized pitches and 5+ follow-ups (follow-ups are where the wins happen)

- Research and build target lists of journalists, podcasts, and YouTube channels

- Cut 5–10 short clips from any recorded appearance within 48 hours (using AI clip tools, we'll train you)

- Draft or help place guest articles

- Deliver a short Friday report: pitches sent, responses, placements, bookings, next week's targets



Ongoing:

- Maintain and grow a clean media contact database

- Spot timely news angles we can react to quickly

- Help keep our content and outreach organized as we scale to multiple brands



WHO YOU ARE

Required:

- Excellent written English: clear, natural, and adaptable in tone (this is the single most important skill)

- A background in journalism, communications, PR, content, or media (studied or worked in it)

- Strong research skills and obsessive attention to detail

- Highly organized: you live in spreadsheets/trackers and never let a follow-up slip

- Self-driven and reliable working remotely with minimal supervision

- Technically open and eager to learn AI tools and new software daily

- Comfortable with high-volume, repetitive execution work done at a high standard



Nice to have:

- Experience with PR/media outreach or journalist databases

- Familiarity with podcasts, the creator economy, or the music/entertainment world

- Basic experience with video clipping tools (CapCut, Opus Clip, Descript), or willingness to learn fast

- Social media content experience



Not required: You don't need existing media contacts or to be a "real" PR manager. We need a brilliant, organized, fast-learning executor. Someone who'll grow with the team.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT

- Work directly with a founder, not buried in a corporate structure

- Learn AI workflows that will make you 10x more valuable in your career

- Be part of launching brands from zero, you'll see your fingerprints on real results

- Long-term, full-time stability with room to grow as we scale



WORK SETUP

- Full-time, ~40 hours/week, remote

- Required overlap with CET (Sweden) hours: e.g. 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM PHT / mornings CET

- Salary: monthly (bi-weekly pay if preferred), based on experience

- Starting: ASAP



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application carefully, and we filter hard for attention to detail. To apply:

1. Start your message with the word "ARCHITECT", followed by your personal birth Zodiac Sign, so we know you read this fully.

2. In 3–4 sentences, tell us about a time you researched and reached out to someone (a journalist, a brand, anyone) and what happened.

3. Share 1–2 short writing samples (anything you've written, an article, a pitch, a post).

4. Tell us: what's one AI tool you've tried, and what did you think of it? (No wrong answer, we just want to see how you think about new tech.)



Applications that don't start with "ARCHITECT" followed by your personal birth Zodiac Sign or include a writing sample will not be reviewed.



We're excited to meet you.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: European Dangerous Goods Logistics Officer
description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented European Dangerous Goods Logistics Officer to support our growing logistics operations across Europe and the UK. This role is ideal for a logistics professional with experience in dangerous goods and HAZMAT operations, particularly involving gas cylinders, who is looking to further develop their career within an international organization.



The successful candidate will work closely with the Logistics team, assisting with the day-to-day coordination of dangerous goods activities while contributing to the continued growth of the business. This position offers excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression.



> **Important:** Applicants must have experience in **European dangerous goods logistics operations involving HAZMAT, particularly gas cylinders**. Candidates without relevant experience in this area will not be considered, and applications that do not meet this essential requirement may be automatically rejected during the screening process.



## Key Responsibilities



* Assist the Logistics team in coordinating European logistics, supply chain, and distribution operations.

* Support the transportation, storage, and handling of dangerous goods and HAZMAT, particularly gas cylinders, in compliance with applicable regulations.

* Coordinate import and export activities and customs procedures across European markets and the UK.

* Ensure adherence to ADR requirements, HAZMAT regulations, and dangerous goods compliance standards.

* Liaise with freight forwarders, transport providers, customs brokers, warehouses, and distribution partners.

* Monitor shipping performance, logistics costs, and service levels.

* Support warehousing, inventory management, and distribution activities involving regulated products.

* Maintain accurate logistics records, shipment documentation, and compliance reports.

* Assist with VAT, customs, and cross-border trading requirements related to logistics operations.

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and support the continued growth of the logistics function.



## Essential Requirements



* Experience in **European dangerous goods logistics operations involving HAZMAT, particularly gas cylinders**.

* Knowledge of ADR regulations and dangerous goods compliance requirements.

* Experience with European import/export procedures, customs requirements, and VAT-related logistics processes.

* Understanding of freight coordination across multiple European markets.

* Proficiency in both written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

* Ability to work collaboratively within a team while managing multiple priorities.



This is an excellent opportunity for a logistics professional with relevant experience in European HAZMAT and dangerous goods operations to join a growing international business. The role is focused on supporting the Logistics team while offering clear growth potential for candidates who demonstrate strong performance and initiative.



Candidates who meet the mandatory requirements and are shortlisted will be contacted regarding the next stage of the recruitment process. We appreciate your interest and thank all applicants for their time and consideration.

title: WordPress / Elementor Production Developer
description:
Job Description: WordPress / Elementor Production Developer



Role Overview

We are hiring a remote WordPress / Elementor Production Developer based in the Philippines to support our growing website operations team.



This role will handle two major areas of work:



Uploading and formatting an increasing number of SEO blog posts across client WordPress websites.

Supporting the revisions department with client-requested website updates that require real WordPress, Elementor, layout, plugin, troubleshooting, and front-end production knowledge.





This is not only a content-entry role. The right person must understand how WordPress websites are built, how Elementor layouts work, and how to safely complete client revision requests without breaking pages, styles, responsiveness, forms, menus, tracking, or site structure.



Key Responsibilities



SEO Blog Post Production

Upload SEO blog posts into WordPress.

Format content using proper headings, spacing, internal links, external links, images, categories, tags, featured images, excerpts, and metadata.

Build or adjust blog layouts using Elementor when needed.

Follow provided SEO instructions for titles, slugs, meta descriptions, alt text, schema/plugin fields, and content structure.

Ensure blog posts match the client’s existing site design and formatting standards.

QA blog posts on desktop and mobile before submitting for review or publishing.





Website Revisions & Client Requests



Complete website revision tasks across multiple client WordPress sites.

Make text, image, layout, button, form, menu, page, section, and styling updates.

Work inside Elementor, Elementor templates, theme settings, widgets, global styles, headers, footers, and reusable sections.

Troubleshoot spacing, mobile responsiveness, broken layouts, missing images, incorrect links, form issues, display problems, and plugin-related conflicts.

Understand when a request is simple content editing versus when it requires developer review or escalation.

Preserve existing site design standards while completing requested changes.

Review completed work carefully before marking tasks ready for QA.





WordPress / Elementor Production Knowledge



The candidate should be able to work confidently with:

WordPress pages, posts, media library, menus, users, settings, and plugins.

Elementor page builder.

Elementor templates, global widgets, headers, footers, archive templates, and single-post templates.

Responsive editing for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Basic HTML and CSS for layout cleanup and minor styling fixes.

Forms, buttons, CTAs, anchor links, popups, menus, and page sections.

Image replacement, resizing, compression, and alt text.

Common SEO plugin fields such as Yoast or Rank Math.

Basic troubleshooting when a page update does not behave as expected.





Required Skills



Strong working experience with WordPress.

Strong working experience with Elementor.

Ability to complete website revision requests accurately from written instructions.

Ability to format and publish blog posts cleanly and consistently.

Basic HTML and CSS knowledge.

Understanding of responsive web design.

Ability to identify when a request may impact site structure, templates, plugins, forms, tracking, or SEO.

Good written English communication.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple tasks across multiple client websites.

Comfortable working from SOPs, checklists, and task management systems.

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during agreed hours.





Preferred Skills



Experience working for a digital marketing agency or website agency.

Experience with Elementor Pro.

Experience with WP Engine or managed WordPress hosting.

Familiarity with ClickUp or similar task management software.

Familiarity with Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, WPForms, or similar form plugins.

Familiarity with Yoast, Rank Math, or similar SEO plugins.

Basic understanding of website accessibility and UX best practices.

Basic understanding of tracking scripts, pixels, and third-party embeds.

Experience doing QA across desktop and mobile.





What This Role Is Not



This is not a simple data-entry role.

This is not only a blog uploader role.

This is not a senior custom-code developer role.

This is a production-level WordPress / Elementor role for someone who can safely handle recurring client website updates, SEO content uploads, formatting, page adjustments, and revision requests with strong judgment and attention to detail.



Success Metrics



Blog posts are uploaded accurately, formatted correctly, and completed on time.

Revision requests are completed with minimal rework.

Completed work passes QA consistently.

Client websites are not broken or negatively impacted during updates.

The person communicates blockers clearly and early.

The revisions department gains real production support, not just content-entry help.





Tools Used



WordPress

Elementor / Elementor Pro

WP Engine or managed WordPress hosting

ClickUp or internal task management system

Google Drive / Docs

SEO plugins such as Yoast or Rank Math

Form plugins such as Gravity Forms or similar

Internal SOPs and QA checklists





Work Arrangement



Remote contractor role based in the Philippines. Full-time preferred. Some overlap with U.S. business hours may be required for handoffs, clarification, and task review

title: AMAZON GRAPHIC DESIGNER - FULL TIME EST
description:
About the Role



FESCO is a consumer goods company that sources and sells branded products across Amazon, Walmart, and Target under licensed brands including CAR&DRIVER, COBY, and PERRY ELLIS. We are looking for a talented and results-driven Graphic Designer who understands the Amazon marketplace inside and out.



This is not a traditional design role. You will be responsible for creating product listings that convert browsers into buyers. That means understanding how to lead with benefits over features, write visual hierarchy that mirrors how shoppers scan Amazon pages, and produce assets that perform against competitors. You will own the full visual output for new product launches and ongoing listing optimization.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon Listing Design



• Design main images, secondary images, and infographic sets for Amazon product detail pages across all active categories

• Build A+ Content (EBC) modules that tell a clear brand story and reinforce purchase confidence

• Translate raw product specs and factory data into customer-facing benefit statements that are visually communicated through icons, callouts, and comparison charts

• Optimize listing visuals for both desktop and mobile views, following Amazon's current image requirements and best practices



Marketing & Brand Design



• Create on-brand advertising creatives for Sponsored Brand, Sponsored Display, and DSP campaigns

• Produce lifestyle imagery concepts, flat-lay compositions, and product mockups to supplement factory photos

• Design promotional graphics for seasonal events (Prime Day, Black Friday, Back to School) that are consistent across all channels

• Support brand licensing requirements by ensuring all creative assets comply with licensor style guides (fonts, colors, logo usage)



Feature/Benefit Communication



• Partner with the product development team to deeply understand each product before designing, reviewing technical specs, competitive listings, and customer reviews to identify the most compelling selling points

• Convert feature lists (materials, dimensions, certifications) into benefit-driven visual messaging that answers the question "why does this matter to the customer?"

• Build comparison charts and competitive differentiator graphics that clearly position FESCO products against category competitors

• Ensure compliance callouts (certifications, safety information, warranty terms) are present and legible without disrupting visual flow



Workflow & Collaboration



• Manage multiple simultaneous product launches, prioritizing based on go-live timelines and pipeline status

• Work within shared SharePoint/OneDrive folders, maintaining clean file organization and version control

• Deliver editable layered source files (PSD, AI, or equivalent) for all completed assets

• Incorporate feedback from A/B testing and listing performance data to iterate on creative over time



Required Qualifications



• 3+ years of graphic design experience with a portfolio that includes Amazon product listings or e-commerce creative

• Demonstrated ability to translate product features and technical specs into clear, benefit-led visual content

• Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign at minimum)

• Solid understanding of Amazon image guidelines, A+ Content requirements, and listing anatomy

• Experience designing for both digital retail and paid advertising placements

• Ability to work independently, hit deadlines, and manage a multi-SKU workload without daily oversight

• Excellent attention to detail, especially with spacing, typography, and brand consistency



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience working with licensed brands and adhering to licensor brand guidelines

• Familiarity with Amazon PPC advertising creative formats including Sponsored Brand video assets

• Background in consumer electronics, home goods, or everyday essentials categories

• Understanding of Amazon's algorithm and how listing quality scores, keywords, and click-through rates relate to design decisions

• Experience with Canva or other scalable design tools for rapid creative iteration

• Basic photo editing and retouching skills to clean up factory or sample photos



What Success Looks Like



In the first 60 days, you will have designed complete image sets for at least 20 active product launches, built familiarity with our brand guidelines and licensed brand requirements, and delivered A+ Content for a priority SKU. Within six months, your work will be measurably impacting conversion rates, and you will be proactively flagging opportunities to improve underperforming listings based on your read of the competitive landscape.



What We Offer



• A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with real ownership over creative output

• Exposure to multiple licensed brands across a diverse product catalog

• Competitive compensation based on experience

•      13th Month Bonus depending on output

• Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangement

• Direct collaboration with product development, sourcing, and Amazon channel management

title: Content Production Partner (Video Editing & Content Creation)
description:
About Oliva Dorado

Oliva Dorado is a premium olive oil brand sourcing organic, early-harvest extra virgin olive oil from a single estate in northern Spain.

We believe great olive oil should be fresh, transparent, and rooted in real food, tradition, and quality. Our content reflects that philosophy through education, storytelling, beautiful visuals, and the Mediterranean lifestyle.

We're looking for a creative Content Production Partner to help us transform our extensive library of raw footage into engaging social media and advertising content.



The Opportunity

We have hundreds of videos from:

- Olive groves in Spain

- Harvest and production

- Bottling and fulfillment

- Founder stories

- Product shoots

- Lifestyle content

- Travel footage

- UGC and affiliate content



We don't need someone to film content.

We need someone who can look through our content library, identify opportunities, and create compelling videos from footage that already exists.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys storytelling, content creation, video editing, and creative problem-solving.



What You'll Do

1. Create Finished Videos

Turn raw footage into engaging short-form content for:

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok

- Meta Ads

- Other social platforms



2. Explore Our Content Library

You'll have access to our Google Drive library and will be expected to:

- Review available footage

- Identify content opportunities

- Organize ideas

- Find creative ways to repurpose existing assets



3. Develop Content Concepts

You'll have creative freedom to:

- Create your own concepts

- Write hooks

- Write on-screen text

- Suggest cover text

- Select music

- Determine pacing and structure

We will also occasionally provide specific content ideas and creative briefs.



4. Maximize Existing Content

One of the most important parts of this role is repurposing.

We don't want one video from a set of footage.

We want someone who can ask:

"How many different videos can I create from these assets?"

A single shoot may become:

- Educational content

- Lifestyle content

- Founder content

- Product content

- Ad creatives

- Aesthetic brand videos



What We're Looking For



Required:

Strong video editing skills

Experience creating short-form social content

Strong understanding of social media trends

Ability to work independently

Creative thinking and storytelling ability

Strong attention to detail



Bonus:

Experience creating Meta ads

Experience editing UGC-style content

Experience working with wellness, food, lifestyle, or premium brands

Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Premiere



Tools:

You may use:

CapCut

Canva

Adobe Premiere

Or your preferred editing software

If needed, we can provide Canva or CapCut access.

All raw footage will be provided through Google Drive.



Deliverables:

Each completed video should include: 

1. Editable project link (Canva or CapCut preferred)

2. If relevant, subtitles, text overlay, voice overs (can be provided)

3. Suggested content category (Educational, Lifestyle, Founder, Product, Ad, etc.)

4. Suggested caption in brands voice optimized for respective social media platform



Important Guidelines:

Content Must Use Our Assets

All videos must be created using footage from our content library.

Please do not use:

Stock footage

AI-generated video

AI-generated people

Third-party clips



Authenticity is extremely important to our brand. Any use of AI for videos or images must be explicitly approved by the brand. 



Brand Style:

Our content is:

- Premium

- Authentic

- Educational

- Intentional

- Warm

- Trustworthy

- Mediterranean-inspired



Our content is not:

- Fear-based

- Clickbait-heavy

- Aggressive

- Overly corporate



Compliance:

We will avoid:

- Medical claims

- Disease prevention or treatment claims

- Attacking specific competitors or brands

- Extreme or sensational health messaging



Hours & Compensation:

Part-time

Flexible schedule

Fully remote

Compensation will be based on experience and portfolio quality.



To Apply:

Please send:

1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Relevant experience

3. Examples of short-form video content you have edited

4. Editing software you prefer to use

5. Why this role interests you



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term creative partner and help us unlock the full potential of our content library. 



This is a part-time role with the potential to grow into a full-time position for the right person, based on performance, initiative, ambition, and alignment with the brand.

title: Vibe Coder (FULL TIME)
description:
Summary

About the role

I run a growing portfolio of online media businesses powered by custom AI tooling. I'm looking for a Vibe Coder / Prompt Engineer to take ownership of building, extending, and maintaining the AI-powered tools, landing pages, and prompt systems that run the operation. This is not a traditional software engineering role — you'll work almost entirely through AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Codex — I provide access) to ship features, fix bugs, and build new products. I don't care how you type the code; I care that what you ship works when I open it.

What you'll do — three areas:



1. Tools & platform. Build and maintain our internal AI production tools end-to-end — front end, backend, AI API integration, deployment. Ship features, fix bugs, keep things stable as we scale, and build integrations with third-party services (image/video generation, TTS, YouTube Data API, Google Drive). Stack is React, TypeScript, Node, tRPC, Tailwind — you should be comfortable working in that even if the AI writes most of the lines, and understand what the code does and how to fix it when it breaks.



2. Landing pages & analytics. Build clean, fast, conversion-focused landing pages and webstores, and a centralized analytics dashboard — a single pane of glass pulling webstore metrics (revenue, conversion, AOV, funnel drop-off) and YouTube metrics (views, CTR, watch time, revenue per channel) so the team has real-time visibility without checking five platforms.



3. Prompt engineering. Write, test, and refine prompts for image, video, and text generation as a core, ongoing part of the work, and bake prompt systems into the tools.



What I'm looking for:



You take a goal and return a working, deployed, tested product — not "done on my machine" or "sitting in a branch." If you tell me it's tested, it's tested.

You're a proactive self-starter. Nobody will write you a detailed spec. You'll get a Loom or a message describing what's needed and figure out the rest. If something breaks, you investigate before being asked. If you spot a better way, you flag it and build it.



You communicate status honestly — "done and live here," or "80% done, blocked on X, here's my plan." Overstating what's finished is the fastest way to not work with me.

You move fast — features in hours, not days — and hit deadlines, or flag early if you can't.



Nice to have (not required): analytics dashboards / YouTube & Google Analytics APIs; Stripe and e-commerce flows; prompt engineering for image/video models; Drizzle ORM or other TypeScript-first stacks.





Hours & working style: Remote, full-time. We move fast and I need you reachable and actively working during core hours, CET time zone.



I care about responsiveness and shipped results, not clock-watching.





Compensation:



Base Retainer (Months 1-3): $600 USD / month

Base Retainer (Month 4+): $800 USD / month (based on performance)

Maximum Monthly Earnings: Up to $2,000 USD / month (base + bonuses)



Paid monthly via Wise.



All tools, AI subscriptions, and API credits are covered by me; you provide your own computer and internet.





Process: a short trial task so I can see how you actually work, then ongoing engagement for strong performers.



To apply — follow these exactly (applications that don't are deleted unread):



Start your message with the word "AVATAR" so I know you read this.



Send 2–3 links to tools you have personally built AND deployed — live URLs I can open and use right now, not just GitHub repos. For one of them, tell me what you built, how much of it you built yourself, what tools you used, and how long it took.

In two sentences: what's one thing you shipped that you're proud of, and what was the hardest part?

Which AI coding tools do you use day to day?



Optional but it helps you stand out: include a short Loom (under 5 minutes) on why you're a great fit. I weigh applicants who do this more heavily — it shows initiative and lets me see how you communicate.

No generic cover letters. Show me you read this. I reply only to applications that follow the steps above.

title: Humbly Confident YouTube Video Editor
description:
WHO WE ARE



We're a small, fast-growing web design agency that works primarily with coaches and expertise-based businesses. We help them grow their businesses through beautiful, strategic web design and marketing.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a skilled Video Editor to join our team and own the editing of our agency's YouTube channel and short-form social content. This content is how we market ourselves and attract new clients, so your work will directly help us grow.



Currently, the owner (that's me, Jennie) films talking-head educational videos and tutorials for service businesses, expertise-based businesses, and online businesses (think coaches, consultants, and more). I handle the filming, scripting, and rough cuts. That means I remove the bad takes and mark up the script with notes on where I think B-roll, graphics, or visual interest should go.



What I need from you is the creative expertise to take that foundation and make it *good*. You'll bring the pacing, transitions, motion graphics, text overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling that turn an educational talking-head video into something people actually want to watch.



This role is primarily focused on long-form YouTube content, with additional light editing on short-form clips (Reels, Shorts, etc.) for our social channels. We'd like to get to 2–3 long-form videos a month and work our way toward weekly long-form over time. I need someone who can grow with us.



You'll report directly to me and collaborate with our team as needed. We'll connect via Zoom as needed, and you're welcome to work normal hours in your time zone.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Your job will be to use your past experience to:



- Edit 2–3 long-form YouTube videos per month from pre-cut raw footage and a marked-up script, working our way toward weekly long-form over time

- Edit approximately 3–5 short-form video clips per week (Reels, Shorts). These are light edits, mostly clipping b-roll I record for funny reels and adding text to them

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, B-roll suggestions, and sound design that make educational content visually engaging

- Bring your own creative perspective. I'll give you editorial notes, but I'm not a video editor, so I really appreciate you bringing your creative eye on what will keep viewers watching

- Maintain meticulous quality control. That means catching audio issues, awkward cuts, mismatched graphics, typos in text overlays, and anything that doesn't feel polished

- Deliver final files on schedule so our publishing workflow stays on track

- Occasionally support a small number of client video projects with similar editing work

- Optional: Create thumbnails for YouTube videos. A great plus, but not required!



EXPERIENCE



We care more about a high skill level than years of experience, but we expect that you have at least 2 years of experience editing video content, ideally for YouTube or other social platforms.



You're proficient with professional editing software. We prefer tools like Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, but we're open to your preferred tool as long as the output is professional quality.



You have a strong eye for pacing and visual storytelling in educational, talking-head content. You know how to keep a viewer engaged through smart cuts, well-timed graphics, and visual variety, even when the core content is someone talking to a camera.



You can work with motion graphics and text overlays confidently. Meaning you should be comfortable creating clean lower thirds and simple graphic elements that make the content easier to follow.



You have meticulous QA habits. You catch audio sync issues, color inconsistencies, typos in on-screen text and awkward transitions before anything is delivered.



Oh, and you get a little thrill when the video you edited becomes an outlier video for the channel!



You're not shy about being (humbly) confident enough to push back and share your creative opinion. If you think a cut isn't working, a graphic would help, or the pacing needs to change, I want to hear it. We encourage that.



You're comfortable collaborating using Google Drive and Zoom, and optionally Notion for our content calendar.



HOW WE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED



We want you to succeed in this role. We will provide any additional training you may need to get on board and hit the ground running. We're not going to teach you how to edit video because your past experience will serve you well.



However, we will train you regarding our brand, our audience, our content style, and our workflow so you can apply your skills to help us achieve our mission. We will listen to you encourage you to bring your entire self to work. We are humans first, work colleagues second.



EMPLOYMENT TYPE



This is a flexible role based on the time it takes to deliver the expected output (2–3 long-form videos per month + 3–5 short-form clips per week). That may be full-time for you, or it may not. We're open to discussing what works. We're not looking for an agency. 



Please begin your cover letter with the title of one of the videos on our YouTube channel at

title: Scheduler
description:
Job Description:

Under the general supervision of the Service Administrator, the Service Coordinator is a critical role responsible for proactively building positive relationships and providing personal, responsive service and attention to our caregivers, our clients, and their families. The Service Coordinator’s primary responsibility is to efficiently match clients with caregivers, ensuring continuity of care, and delivering exceptional customer service.

Key Responsibilities:

• Efficiently schedule caregivers to match them with clients, taking into account preferences, availability, and skills.

• Handle daily changes in client schedules and caregiver call-offs with a sense of urgency, ensuring immediate replacement.

• Collaborate with Care Coordinators and other Service Coordinators to establish consistent caregiving teams for clients.

• Maintain open and effective communication with caregivers, clients, and their families, promptly addressing any scheduling conflicts or changes.

• Update client’s schedules and details when needed and follow through to ensure everyone is communicated with properly.

• Ensure the caregiver’s credentials match client’s needs.

• Provide excellent customer service by being kind, genuine, and attentive to client and caregiver needs.

• Act as a critical thinker, able to see the bigger picture in terms of scheduling and client care.

• Adhere to company policies and procedures, including the use of scheduling software, Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom and maintaining accurate records.

• Continuously strive for operational excellence and success in your role as a Service Coordinator.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive.  The employee will be expected to perform other reasonable related duties as assigned.



Core Qualities and Attributes

1. Efficiency: Service Coordinators manage complex schedules, so they should be efficient in organizing and optimizing caregiver-client matches to ensure seamless service delivery.

2. Clear Communication: Effective communication with caregivers, clients, and their families is vital to handle scheduling changes and conflicts promptly and maintain transparency.

3. Adaptability: Scheduling can be dynamic, so Service Coordinators adapt to changing circumstances and adjust schedules accordingly.

4. Attention to Detail: Precision is crucial to ensure that caregivers are matched appropriately with clients and that schedules are error-free.

5. Sense of Urgency: Service Coordinators respond quickly to client scheduling needs and caregiver call-offs to maintain continuity of care.

6. Empathy: A compassionate approach when dealing with clients and caregivers fosters positive relationships and enhances the overall care experience.

7. Problem-Solving Skills: Service Coordinators are critical thinkers who can identify and resolve scheduling issues efficiently.

8. Customer Service Orientation: They must provide exceptional customer service to clients and caregivers, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded.

9. Reliability: Clients and caregivers depend on Service Coordinators to ensure consistent care, so reliability is crucial.

10. Technology Proficiency: Familiarity with scheduling software (e.g., Outlook, Microsoft Teams), as well as basic Microsoft Word and Excel skills, can help streamline scheduling tasks.

11. Responsible and Accountable: Service Coordinators are responsible for maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with company policies and labor laws.

12. Passion for In-Home Care: Having a genuine passion for making a positive impact in the field of in-home care is essential for motivating and driving success in this role.

13. Hardworking: Service Coordinators should be dedicated and hardworking individuals who are committed to the success of the caregiving team.

14. Kindness: A kind and compassionate demeanor can go a long way in building positive relationships with clients and caregivers, creating a nurturing care environment.

Key Success Factors for the Scheduler Role

In summary, the Scheduler plays a crucial role in ensuring the seamless coordination of caregivers and clients, building continuity in care, and providing exceptional customer service. Success in this role involves efficient scheduling, clear communication, employee satisfaction, meeting client needs, and strict adherence to company policies. 

Required Skills / Abilities:

• Active communication techniques including listening, expressing ideas and concerns, questioning and presenting.

• Is responsive to the needs of others and is a team player who demonstrates a commitment to co-workers and to company vision, values and goals.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Windows. 

• High level of judgement and confidentiality related to client privacy and HIPAA compliance. 

• The ability to manage competing demands and adapt quickly and positively to frequent changes, delays or unexpected events.

• Attention to detail, completing and documenting tasks and interactions in a thorough manner.



Education and Experience: 

• High School diploma or GED and two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Must be able to successfully pass a nationwide criminal background check.

• Must possess a valid driver’s license and have access to reliable transportation.

Wick of Hope and Launch & Found are hiring a dedicated Business Development

Representative to own the top of our sales funnel: sourcing prospects, getting

them on the phone, and booking qualified appointments for our closer. This is

a senior, phone-first role for an experienced outbound professional who runs

independently and holds themselves to a high standard.



About Us

You will represent two businesses, one team, run by the same founders.



Wick of Hope is a fast-growing Canadian candle brand built on a simple idea,

that a small light can carry a lot of hope. We have sold more than 20,000

candles, earned over 600 five-star reviews, and we give back to causes our

customers care about.



Launch & Found is our SaaS and growth marketing agency. We give local service

businesses one system that gets them found and gets them booked: a

conversion-focused website, missed-call text-back, automated lead follow-up,

review generation, and local SEO, all on one flat monthly rate. Clients ready

to scale add paid advertising, professional video, and an AI receptionist.

Our market is local business owners across Canada and the US.



We are a small, fast-moving team that takes pride in excellent work and

treats its people well.



The Role

You will own the entire top of our sales funnel, from first list to booked

meeting, across both brands.

- You source your own prospects. We do not hand you lists. You build them,

with the owner's name and direct line. For Wick of Hope: boutique gift shops

and independent retailers across Canada and the US. For Launch & Found: local

service businesses (contractors, trades, home services, and similar

owner-operated companies) across Canada and the US.

- You reach the right person. You build rapport with whoever answers, turn

the gatekeeper into an ally, and get to the decision-maker.

- You sell the meeting. You will not close the deal yourself, our closer does

that, but you are selling on every call: opening with confidence, creating

genuine interest, handling objections, and booking the appointment.

- You sustain your 
ntum. You bring the same energy to your ninetieth call

of the day as your first.



What You Will Own

- A pipeline you have sourced yourself, across both brands

- 75 to 150+ quality dials per day

- [X]+ qualified appointments booked each week

- An accurate, up-to-date CRM your closer can rely on



What You Bring

- Several years of outbound phone sales, appointment setting, or SDR

experience

- A proven ability to build B2B lead lists from scratch with tools such as

Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or Google Maps

- Confidence and warmth on the phone, with a calm, skilled way of handling

objections and gatekeepers

- The range to carry two pitches: a beloved consumer brand for retail buyers,

and a growth system for business owners

- Clear, easy-to-understand English (our buyers are in Canada and the US)

- The discipline to run your own desk with minimal supervision



What We Offer

- Growth: as our first BDR, you will build the playbook and grow as we do

- Range: two brands and two buyer types from one desk, so the work stays

sharp

- Direct access: you work closely with our founders and our closer, not

buried under layers of management

- Purpose: you will represent a brand people genuinely love and an agency

that helps small businesses win

- Real upside: a competitive base plus an uncapped bonus on every appointment

that shows

- Balance: clear hours, a supportive remote team, and no weekend work



How to Apply

We review every application personally. Please send:

2. Three sentences on why this role is right for you and what you would

bring.



Applicants who complete both steps will be reviewed first. We look forward to

hearing from you.



Andy

Co-Founder

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

Reporting and Performance Analysis



• Pull and interpret Business Reports, Inventory Performance data, and advertising reports on a weekly and monthly basis

• Build and maintain performance dashboards in Google Sheets or Excel to track key KPIs across the catalog

• Identify trends, flag issues proactively, and present actionable recommendations to internal stakeholders



Requirements



• 3 or more years of direct experience managing an Amazon Seller Central account (FBA and FBM)

• Experience selling on additional platforms such as Walmart Marketplace or Target Plus

• Deep familiarity with Seller Central tools including Manage Inventory, Inventory Planning, Shipment Queue, Advertising Console, Brand Registry, and Account Health

• Proficiency with flat file templates and bulk upload processes across multiple product categories

• Solid understanding of FBA cost structure including referral fees, fulfillment fees, and storage fees

• Excellent written communication skills for drafting listing copy, Seller Support cases, and internal reporting

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities at once



Nice to Have



• Familiarity with third-party tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, Pacvue, Perpetua, Sellersprite

• Background working with licensed consumer brands or in a product sourcing / import environment

• Basic understanding of dimensional weight, freight terms, and import logistics



What You Will Own



You will have direct ownership over Amazon catalog health, FBA inventory operations, advertising performance, and account compliance. You will work closely with the product and sourcing team to launch new items, maintain existing listings, and grow our Amazon revenue. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with real ownership from day one.

description:
Zoyava is a fast-growing digital-native supplement brand focused on building premium wellness products that consumers genuinely love. As we continue scaling across major eCommerce marketplaces, Walmart Marketplace has become a key strategic growth channel for the business.



We are looking for a highly experienced Walmart Operations Lead to take ownership of Walmart Marketplace performance, drive operational excellence, and help scale the channel into a major revenue driver for the company.



This is a leadership role for someone who understands Walmart deeply, thinks strategically about growth, communicates clearly with leadership, and can build scalable systems across catalog, advertising, inventory, promotions, and reporting.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re seeking a highly analytical, growth-oriented operator with deep Walmart Marketplace experience who can lead the day-to-day operations and long-term strategy of the Walmart channel.



This role is ideal for someone who has successfully scaled brands on Walmart Marketplace, understands Walmart Connect advertising, knows how to improve operational performance, and can proactively identify growth opportunities while keeping leadership informed through strong reporting and business insights.



You should be comfortable owning the Walmart business like it’s your own.



Key Responsibilities



Walmart Marketplace Ownership



• Lead and oversee all Walmart Marketplace operations across the brand.

• Own channel growth, revenue performance, profitability, and operational execution.

• Develop and execute Walmart growth strategies focused on sales expansion, margin improvement, and market share.

• Manage end-to-end catalog operations including listings, variations, compliance, SEO, inventory health, and pricing. • Ensure all listings are optimized for discoverability, conversion, and Walmart algorithm performance.

• Monitor account health, policy compliance, suppression risks, and operational KPIs.



Walmart Growth & Strategy



• Identify new opportunities for growth through assortment expansion, promotions, pricing strategies, search visibility, and advertising optimization.

• Analyze category trends, competitor activity, and Walmart platform changes to maintain competitive advantage.

• Develop launch strategies for new products and ensure successful execution on Walmart Marketplace.

• Drive initiatives that improve conversion rate, traffic, ROAS, contribution margin, and repeat purchase behavior.



Walmart Connect Advertising



• Lead Walmart Connect advertising strategy and execution.

• Oversee campaign structure, keyword targeting, bidding strategy, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.

• Continuously optimize ad efficiency and profitability through data analysis and testing.

• Report on advertising performance, attribution, TACOS, ROAS, and growth opportunities.



Leadership Reporting & Business Insights



• Build and maintain clear reporting systems for leadership.

• Provide weekly and monthly business updates with actionable insights, growth opportunities, risks, and operational recommendations.

• Track and report key Walmart KPIs including revenue, profitability, conversion rate, traffic, ROAS/TACOS, Buy Box %, inventory health, advertising efficiency, and listing health.

• Present strategic recommendations backed by data.

title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Outbound Sales Representative
description:
The Role

We are looking for a hungry, resilient, and highly articulate Outbound Sales Representative to join our remote team on a part-time basis. Your primary goal will be to generate new business leads and book qualified appointments for our agency by reaching out to UK-based businesses.



Commission Structure: 4% per closed web/app project (avg. deal size: £2–3k / ~£80–£120 commission per sale)



You will be the first point of contact for potential clients, pitching our web design, app development, and SEO services. Because you will be speaking directly with UK business owners and decision-makers, a neutral accent, exceptional English, and a confident phone manner are absolutely essential.



Key Responsibilities

• Outbound Prospecting: Identify and research potential B2B clients in the UK who could benefit from a new website, app, or improved SEO.

• Cold Calling &
ing: Execute high-volume outbound campaigns (cold calls,
s, and LinkedIn outreach) to introduce Dorset Tech's services.

• Lead Qualification: Ask the right questions to qualify prospects based on their budget, timeline, and technical needs.

• Appointment Setting: Book qualified discovery calls and consultations for our senior team to close (or, if you have the experience, close them yourself).

• CRM Management: Keep meticulous records of all calls,
s, and follow-ups in our CRM system.



Requirements

• B2B Sales Experience: Proven track record in outbound sales, cold calling, or appointment setting, preferably within the tech, SaaS, or digital agency space.

• Exceptional English: Flawless spoken and written English with a neutral or easily understood accent. You must be comfortable navigating conversations with UK business owners.

• Resilience: You must be comfortable with rejection and possess the drive to keep dialing and following up.

• Tech-Savvy: A basic understanding of web design (WordPress), SEO, and app development so you can speak credibly about our services.

• Availability: Must be available to work from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM UK time (which is 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM in the Philippines), Monday through Friday.



About Dorset Tech

We are Dorset's number one web design agency, and we are on a mission to disrupt the web design industry. We pride ourselves on offering the lowest rates in the country without compromising on quality, serving over 2,000 active support customers. We build everything from budget pay-monthly sites to full custom Laravel systems and Flutter mobile apps.



Beyond our technical expertise, we are a social enterprise and a carbon-negative company. We power our office with solar energy, drive electric cars, and plant a tree for every review we receive. If you want to sell a product you can genuinely believe in, for a company that cares about its community and the planet, Dorset Tech is the place for you.



Probation Period: Initial schedule will be 4–6 hours daily during probation, with transition to full-time expected within 2 months.



How to Apply

Please apply with your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your previous cold calling or B2B sales experience. Important: Please include a short audio or video recording introducing yourself and giving us a 30-second "mock pitch" of a web design service. Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: Executive & Personal Assistant to the CEO/Founder
description:
Location: Remote (occasional travel may be required)



High-growth Australian-based company helping service-based businesses scale through world-class sales support. 



Join Start-Up of the Year & Young Entrepreneur of the Year finalist, Cam, on his endeavours to spearhead global growth.



We’re searching for an Executive & Personal Assistant to the CEO who’s not afraid to work closely and get their hands dirty.



This is not for the shy. You will be required to travel 1-week in every 5-weeks and work in close quarters. 



You must be more than just organised - we want someone who becomes the trusted right hand, the safe sounding board, and the quiet force behind the scenes that keeps the CEO at the top of their game.



Why This Role Matters

This isn’t a calendar-and-coffee EA role. You’ll be the strategic partner… someone who can anticipate needs, solve problems before they escalate, and help drive the business forward.



In this role, you’ll develop a deep, professional working partnership with the CEO - what we call the “EA work-wife mentality.” That means building trust, understanding priorities, and becoming the go-to person for critical, confidential, and often time-sensitive matters. You’ll know when to offer support, when to challenge ideas, and when to protect their time and headspace.



You’ll Be Perfect For This Role If You…

 • Have proven EA or senior-level support experience.

 • Thrive in a high-trust, high-discretion working relationship.

 • Can manage confidential information with absolute integrity.

 • Are adaptable — equally happy booking a last-minute flight as you are reviewing a strategic plan.

 • Can work independently, often at a healthy distance from the broader team, without losing connection.

 • Love bringing order to chaos, and can keep your cool in fast-moving situations.

 • Have strong business acumen and understand the commercial impact of your work.

 • Possess a valid passport and are comfortable with occasional international travel whereas you'd be staying in close quarters with the CEO.



What Your Days Might Look Like

 • Acting as the gatekeeper for the CEO’s time, priorities, and focus.

 • Managing complex schedules, travel, and logistics across time zones.

 • Preparing briefs, reports, and follow-ups for meetings and projects.

 • Handling sensitive correspondence and acting as the CEO’s representative.

 • Stepping into operational or project-based tasks when urgent business needs arise.

 • Identifying process improvements and implementing smarter ways of working.





The Boundaries & Balance

We value a strong working partnership. You’ll be close to the CEO’s world, yet skilled at protecting both your time and theirs. You’ll know when to lean in for support and when to step back to maintain perspective



What We Offer

 • Competitive salary + performance incentives.

 • A role that is both strategic and hands-on.

 • The opportunity to work directly with the founder of a rapidly scaling company.

 • Flexibility to work remotely, with occasional travel for in-person collaboration.

 • A supportive environment where your contribution has visible impact.



If you’re the kind of person who thrives in a close, trusted working partnership — where your job is to make the CEO more effective every single day — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Instagram Account Sourcing VA (Motivation / Mindset Niche)
description:
I'm looking for someone resourceful to find Instagram accounts available for purchase in the motivation/mindset space. You'll source accounts, vet them hard for quality, and open conversations with owners. This is a research + outreach role. I need someone who can dig, tell a genuine account from a manipulated one, and follow through.

What You'll Do



Find Instagram accounts for sale that match the criteria below

Source through account marketplaces (SWAPD, Fameswap, brokers) and direct outreach to page owners

Vet every account for genuine engagement and real followers — anything botted or manipulated is an instant no

For each account, send me: follower count, audience demographics, engagement data, posting frequency, and asking price

Track everything in a Google Sheet

Send opening messages to owners using templates I provide



Account Criteria



Followers: 50,000–100,000 ideal. Can stretch to ~130,000 for the right account.

Audience (most important): primarily English-speaking, ideally USA, UK, Australia, Ireland, Canada and similar. Audience quality matters more than raw follower count.

Format: Reels-focused. Not interested in photo-based pages.

Niche: motivation, success, mindset, business, entrepreneurship, celebrity/inspirational quotes. Motivational content is first choice.

Audience split: fairly balanced by gender, not heavily skewed one way.

Quality: consistent posting history and genuine engagement. No fake followers, no botted engagement, nothing that looks manipulated.



Who I'm Looking For



Strong written English (you'll be doing outreach)

Knows Instagram and how account marketplaces work

Sharp eye for fake followers and manipulated engagement

Organised, reliable, communicates progress daily

Comfortable in Google Sheets



To Apply



List 2–3 Instagram accounts that could be a fit, with one line on why for each.

Tell me how you'd check whether an account's followers and engagement are genuine.

Start your reply with the word SOURCE so I know you read this.
