title: Appointment Setter / SDR - US Accent Required - $12/hr + $100/Show - 3+ Yrs Killers
description:
SALES KILLERS ONLY. NO ENTRY-LEVEL. NO EXCEPTIONS.



ENGLISH IS THE FILTER. We need a US or neutral accent. If a US prospect can't understand you in the first 5 seconds of your video, you cannot do this job. Heavy regional accent = auto-reject. No exceptions.



We're a US lead-gen agency hiring ONE savage. You run our warm reply inbox, call those warm leads, and dial cold B2B lists. You book qualified calls. We close them.



THE BAR (English and accent are EVERYTHING)

- PERFECT spoken English with a US or NEUTRAL accent. Native-level only. If we hear a heavy regional accent in the first 5 seconds of your video, we stop watching.

- PERFECT written English. Tested in the application below.

- 3+ years calling US prospects (B2B appointment setting, SDR, or cold calling). Bonus if you've worked at a US-based agency.

- You can name the agency, the campaigns, and your best month's number.

- CRM and dialer fluent.

- Quiet workspace, fiber internet, headset. Full-time, US Eastern hours.



DO NOT APPLY IF YOU

- Have a strong regional accent that US prospects struggle to follow on a call.

- Have under 3 years calling US prospects.

- Need a script handed to you on every call.

- Are juggling other full-time clients.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Reply to warm inbox leads within 10 minutes and call them to book the meeting.

- Dial cold B2B lists (we provide data and dialer). Open hard. Handle "no." Book.

- Log every outcome cleanly so we can coach you and pay you on time.



THE PAY (built so killers get paid)

- $12/hour base = $2,100/month full-time.

- Plus $100 per qualified call you book that shows. Uncapped.

- Plus $1,000/month bonus when you hit 20+ showed calls in a month.

- Top performers clear $4,000/month. When you crush it: more clients, more hours, bigger comp.



HOW TO APPLY (do all 4. Missing any = auto-reject.)

1. Start your message with "SAVAGE".

2. Record a 60-second video ON CAMERA, face visible (Loom, Drive, or YouTube unlisted) answering: A prospect picks up and says "Not interested, we handle this in-house." What do you say to keep them on the line and book the call? WE'RE JUDGING YOUR ACCENT AND ENGLISH FIRST. Sales instinct second.

3. Type (no AI, no copy-paste) your years of US-prospect phone experience, the agency or company name, and your best month's number of qualified meetings booked.

4. Type your internet speed and the US Eastern hours you can work full-time.



NO US/NEUTRAL ACCENT = NO READ. NO VIDEO = NO READ. NO "SAVAGE" = NO READ. WEAK ENGLISH = NO READ. GENERIC = NO READ.

We work with founders, service-based businesses, and B2B companies across various industries, helping them create meaningful content, build authority, and attract new clients online.

We're looking for a tech-savvy, proactive person to coordinate our technology, AI tools, and integrations — making sure everything behind the scenes runs smoothly.



Role Overview

This is a flexible, part-time role that combines AI and automation work with general technical operations.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys connecting tools, automating repetitive work, and quietly making everything run better. You'll be the go-to person for anything technical in the business.

You don't need to be a software developer. What matters most is that you're hands-on with modern tools, a confident troubleshooter, and comfortable taking ownership of systems while keeping things documented and organised.

A key part of this role involves setting up and maintaining AI tools and automations, connecting our platforms so data flows correctly between them, resolving technical issues quickly, and helping the team work more efficiently through smart use of technology.



Key Responsibilities

AI & Automation

Set up, manage, and improve AI tools and workflows (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, content and image tools)

Build and maintain automations using platforms like Zapier, Make, or n8n

Create prompts, templates, and simple internal guides for the team

Research new AI tools and recommend what's worth adopting



Integrations & Systems

Connect and maintain our software stack (CRM,
, scheduling, project management, and social media tools)

Make sure data flows correctly between platforms

Manage accounts, access, and permissions securely

Keep systems documentation and SOPs up to date



Technical Operations

Monitor that automations and integrations are running smoothly

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues for the team

Support tracking, reporting, and data hygiene across our tools

Assist with ad hoc technical projects as needed



Who We're Looking For

Hands-on experience with AI tools and automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)

Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and connecting tools together

Strong problem-solver who can troubleshoot independently

Excellent written English — able to explain technical things in plain language

Highly organised, dependable, and careful with access and data

Comfortable following systems and processes while looking for ways to improve them

Able to work independently without constant supervision

Proactive and resourceful — spots issues before they become problems

Positive attitude and willingness to learn



Availability Requirements

This role requires someone who can check in, respond to messages, and resolve any issues, with availability that overlaps with UK (London) working hours. Occasionally, urgent technical issues may need a faster response.



Why Join Us?

Flexible remote work

Approximately 10–15 hours per week

Full training on our internal systems and processes

Opportunity to grow with a growing marketing agency

Varied, hands-on work with the latest AI tools

Supportive and collaborative environment



How to Apply

AI-generated applications will not be considered,  yes, even for an AI role. We are interested in your own thinking, communication style, and writing ability.

title: Job Title: Amazon Returns Specialist (FBA / FBM)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Amazon Returns Specialist to take full control of our FBA and FBM returns pipeline. You will be responsible for auditing return data, maximizing recovery by routing items to the correct channels (Amazon, eBay, or Amazon Claims), and creating standard operating procedures (SOPs) for our customer service team and 3PL warehouses to follow.



Key Responsibilities:

Track & Audit: Monitor and reconcile all FBA/FBM returns inside Amazon Seller Central.

Triage Inventory: Classify every return into three distinct routes:

Route A: Re-sellable on Amazon.

Route B: Damaged/Open-box $\rightarrow$ Route to eBay for resale.

Route C: Carrier/Amazon damaged $\rightarrow$ File for Reimbursement.

Claims Management: File and win SAFE-T and FBA reimbursement claims.

SOP Creation: Write clear, step-by-step processes for Customer Service (tracking/validation) and 3PL Warehouses (inspection/sorting/photos).



Requirements:

2+ years of experience managing Amazon FBA/FBM returns and inventory reconciliation.

Proven track record of winning Amazon reimbursement and SAFE-T claims.

Experience writing SOPs or workflows for remote teams or logistics partners.

Familiarity with eBay listing and condition guidelines is a plus.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for data tracking.

title: Video Editor
description:
Company Overview:



At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space that are in the health and wellness space. With creativity at our core, we strive to push the boundaries of ecommerce marketing, making an indelible impact on the industry.



Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Video Editor to join our dynamic team for a full time role. This individual will play a crucial role in post-production video editing, creating engaging and effective video assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing.



Qualifications:

At least 2 years of experience in video editing within the ecommerce marketing space, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and Davinci.

Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos.

A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous.

Agency experience is a plus

Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others

BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work

Fluency in English is required.



Key Competencies:

Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts.

Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets.

A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation.

Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative.

Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content.

A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns.

You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on.



Overview:

Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.



Working Hours:

This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.



Expectations:

Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines.

Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.



Tools and Software:

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected.



Compensation:

The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role:



Compensation: Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application.

Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it.



Expectations and Growth:

This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced.



We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns.





To Apply:

To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form that is 27 questions in total. 



You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.

title: Role Focus: Global eBay & Multi-Marketplace Manager
description:
Role Overview

This role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our global e-commerce presence. Utilizing our already established corporate entities, the manager will spearhead the technical setup of eBay accounts across the US, UK, and EU, manage daily full-cycle storefront operations, and scale inventory across non-Amazon third-party marketplaces.



Part 1: Initial Launch & Compliance (Phase 1)

The manager takes ownership from the point of account creation, ensuring compliance with global platform regulations to eliminate setup friction.



Global KYC & Account Onboarding: Establish native corporate accounts on 
, 
, and EU nodes (
, 
, etc.). Flawlessly execute eBay’s Managed Payments onboarding by mapping existing corporate registry documents, director IDs, and localized business bank accounts/payout providers.



Tax Integration & Infrastructure: Input and verify existing VAT registrations for UK/EU regions and configure regional sales tax/nexus tables for the US.



Security & Environment Management: Implement clean environment protocols (dedicated IPs, multi-user access controls) to prevent malicious or a
 account linkage flags.



Part 2: Daily Full-Cycle Operations (Phase 2)

Once accounts are live, the manager handles the day-to-day operations required to convert listings into sustained sales.



1. Catalog Management & Listing Optimization

Search Engine Optimization: Maximize visibility within eBay’s Cassini search algorithm by optimizing titles (80-character limit), populating all critical Item Specifics, and structuring clean, mobile-optimized descriptions.



Bulk Ingestion: Manage multi-variation listings (sizes, specs, colors) across international storefronts via CSV/XLSX file exchanges or listing software.



2. Order Triage & Global Logistics

Dispatch Management: Monitor the Awaiting Postage queue daily, coordinating with fulfillment channels to ensure strict adherence to stated handling times.



Cross-Border Shipping: Configure localized shipping tables, coordinate with international carriers, or leverage programs like eBay International Shipping to maintain defect-free tracking upload rates.



3. Account Health & Risk Mitigation

Performance Monitoring: Protect Top Rated Seller standing by managing transaction defect rates, late shipments, and cases closed without seller resolution.



Policy Compliance: Proactively monitor the Resolution Center for VeRO (Intellectual Property) warnings, policy updates, and listing errors.



4. Marketing & Revenue Growth

Advertising Strategy: Deploy and optimize Promoted Listings Standard and Advanced (CPC) campaigns to capture high-intent search traffic.



Promotional Campaigns: Launch store sales, multi-buy discounts, and targeted buyer coupons to increase Average Order Value (AOV).



5. Customer Experience & Dispute Resolution

Buyer Communications: Maintain a strict 24-hour response window for pre- and post-sale messages.



Claims Handling: Authoritatively manage returns, cancellations, and "Item Not As Described" (INAD) claims, using tactical partial refunds to safeguard profit margins.



Part 3: Multi-Channel Expansion (Phase 3)

Beyond eBay, this role is tasked with replicating product visibility across alternative high-yield marketplaces.



Platform Diversification: Scale catalog presence onto non-Amazon channels such as Walmart Marketplace (US), Target Plus (US), Kaufland (DE), Allegro (PL), or Mirakl-powered enterprise networks.



Centralized Inventory Syncing: Implement and oversee multi-channel management tools (e.g., Linnworks, BaseLinker, ChannelAdvisor) to ensure live stock allocations prevent overselling across global nodes.



Requirements:

2-5 Years of experience with EBAY.



Thank you

title: Outbound Sales Caller: eCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery
description:
Before you apply, please read this whole post. I'm looking for one specific type of person, and the application instructions at the bottom are designed to filter out everyone who isn't. If you follow them, you'll stand out immediately.



I run a fast growing ecommerce store. Every day, dozens of customers add products to their cart and then leave without buying. Your job is to call those people, win them back, and close the sale over the phone. You get a monthly base plus a cash bonus for every cart you recover. The better you are, the more you earn, with no cap.



This is phone work. If you love being on the phone and you're motivated by hitting targets, keep reading. If you'd rather do quiet admin or data entry, this is not the role for you.



What you'll actually be doing:



1.Calling customers who abandoned their cart, usually within minutes to hours of them leaving the site

2. Reopening the conversation, handling objections (price, hesitation, "just looking", "I'll do it later"), and getting them to complete the purchase

3. Following up by call, SMS or
 where needed

4. Logging every call outcome accurately so we can track what's working

5. Hitting daily call volume and weekly recovery targets



What success looks like:

You'll be measured on three things-



1. Dials and contacts per day (your activity)

2. Contact-to-recovery conversion rate (your skill)

3. Total carts recovered per week (the outcome that earns your bonus)



I'll give you clear targets in week one and review your numbers with you weekly. Strong performers get more hours, more responsibility, and a bigger bonus structure over time.



Must-haves (please don't apply without these):



1. Proven outbound phone experience: telesales, appointment setting, cold calling, collections, or BPO outbound campaigns. Tell me exactly what you did.

2. Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, confident phone voice

3. Genuine comfort and enjoyment on the phone, plus thick skin for rejection

4. Availability during Australian hours, roughly 10am to 8pm AEST (about 8am to 6pm Philippine time), since our customers are in Australia

5. Reliable high speed internet, a good quality headset, and a quiet place to call from

6. Reliability and honest reporting. I track outcomes, so there is nowhere to hide a slow day, and I reward consistency.



Nice-to-haves (not necessary but will help you stand out):



1. Experience with WooCommerce, which is the platform we use day to day

2. Experience in DTC ecommerce or with consumer products

3. Experience selling to Australian or other Western customers

4. Familiarity with diallers, SMS tools, or CRMs in general

5. Experience working to a commission or bonus structure before



About the product (so you can self-select):



We sell nicotine products to adult customers in Australia. You must be comfortable calling on behalf of an adult nicotine product. If that's a problem for you, this isn't the right fit, and that's completely fine.



Pay:



1. Starting rate: USD $6 per hour, paid for every hour you work from day one. This is your guaranteed base and it does not go away.



2. The first two weeks are a paid probation on this flat hourly rate while we assess how you perform.



3. After you pass probation, you keep the hourly base and move onto a performance bonus for every cart you recover. This is where the real money is. The earning potential is high and completely uncapped: the more carts you recover, the more you make, on top of your hourly rate.



4. To be clear, this is a real job with a guaranteed wage, not commission-only work. But if you're a strong closer, the bonus will quickly become the biggest part of your pay.



5. We pay on time, every time.



Hours:



We expect a minimum commitment of 38 hours per week during the Australian calling window above. However, since this is a bonus-driven job, you may choose to work more hours to increase your earnings. 



How to apply:

I will only read applications that do all three of these -



1. Start your message with the word RINGER. This tells me you read the entire post. Applications without it get deleted unread.



2. Attach a voice recording, maximum 60 seconds. Pretend you're calling a customer who left a few tins of nicotine pouches in their cart and didn't check out. Win them back. I want to hear your real phone voice, your tone, and how you'd open the call. Don't overthink it, just record it. Feel free to make up any commercial points such as fast shipping, best prices etc. If you are unaware of nicotine pouches, please look up ZYN and VELO prior to making your recording. These are the 2 key brands that we retail. 



3. Answer these three questions briefly: 1. How many months or years of outbound phone experience do you have, and what kind of campaigns (AU/US sales, appointment setting, collections, and so on)? 2. What dialler or CRM tools have you used? 3. What were you measured on in your last phone role, and what numbers did you actually hit?



That's it. If you're a genuine phone closer who reads instructions and follows them, you'll be miles ahead of most applicants. I'm ready to hire quickly for the right person.

title: E-commerce Assistant Store Manager
description:
We operate three profitable E-commerce stores and are currently launching our fourth. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a highly experienced E-commerce Assistant Store Manager to handle day-to-day operations, support customers across multiple channels, and help keep our systems running smoothly.



This is a senior-level role with long-term potential for the right candidate. Please read the full job description and answer all questions for your application to be considered.



IMPORTANT: Please read the entire job description and follow the application instructions carefully to be considered.



Responsibilities

• Manage customer inquiries via phone,
, and chat with professionalism and accuracy.

• Handle RFQs, returns/exchanges, complaints, disputes, and negative reviews.

• Collect and maintain positive customer reviews and overall satisfaction.

• Support sales-related tasks and assist in improving store performance.

• Collaborate with the CS, Orders, and Product teams to share insights and ensure a consistent customer experience.

• Identify process gaps, recommend improvements, and contribute to SOP updates.

• Perform daily administrative tasks, including EOS reports and operational updates.

• Proactively manage assigned tasks without waiting for instructions.



What You Need to Succeed -



Required Experience:

• 2+ years in E-commerce operations (customer service + order management + product management).

• Proven Shopify experience (listings, inventory, bulk updates, app usage).

• Strong phone communication skills and ability to handle challenging conversations calmly.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail (include the word mushroom in your application).



Technical Requirements:

• Proficiency in Shopify, ClickUp, Airtable, CRM tools, and Google Workspace.

• Reliable computer + 20 Mbps+ internet.

• Backup solutions for both power and internet outages.



Work Style:

• Self-directed - you take initiative and solve problems independently.

• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy.

• Customer-focused - complaints are opportunities to improve systems.

• Process-minded - you document and refine workflows naturally.



Work Schedule:

• Full-time, 40 hours/week

• US business hours: 9 PM–6 AM or 10 PM–7 AM PHT

• 1-hour break

• Five days per week



You're NOT a Fit If:

• You need micromanagement or detailed daily task lists

• You can't work 9 PM–7 AM PHT consistently

• You experience frequent power/internet outages without backup solutions

• You view this as temporary income between other opportunities



Before You Apply - Please Confirm:

• Weekly payments for the first 4 weeks (starting from week 3), then bi-monthly every other Tuesday.

• Full-time role, US hours.

• Must be open to a two-month trial period.

• Daily End of Shift (EOS) report answering:

a) What did you do today? (detailed description)

b) What issues did you run into?

c) Anything you need help with?

If you agree to all terms, write “I AGREE TO ALL TERMS” and answer the questions below.



Application Instructions (Follow Exactly) -



Subject Line:

[Your First Name] – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager

Example: Kevin – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager



Submit:

• Cover letter (focused on relevant e-commerce experience)

• Resume



Answer These Questions (Complete Sentences Required):

1. Describe your most relevant e-commerce operations experience (platforms used, team size, order volume, responsibilities).

2. What specific Shopify tasks have you performed?

3. What are your current work commitments and availability?

4. Provide your internet speed (include screenshot), computer specifications, and backup solutions for power & internet issues.

5. Provide one example of a difficult customer situation you handled and how you resolved it.

6. Why are you interested in this specific role instead of other VA positions?



Important: AI-generated or template responses will be immediately disqualified. We're looking for thoughtful, specific answers that demonstrate you read and understood this posting.

title: Lead Research & Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Lead Research & Outreach Virtual Assistant to support our team in identifying, verifying, and engaging potential property owners and decision-makers. This role will start with data research and lead validation (Phase 1) and evolve into outreach and cold calling (Phase 2) to help generate qualified meetings and business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Phase 1: Lead Research & Data Management

-Gather and verify contact information including
s and phone numbers

Tools & Systems

 and phone verification tools

title: Real Estate Media Editor — Cinematic Video & HDR Photos (Video & Photo Editor)
description:
Company: Boyers Media (US-based multimedia company)

Location: Full-time remote — Philippines-based applicants only

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week, working hours preferably within US Eastern business hours (7:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST / 7:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila time)



About the Role



Boyers Media is looking for a full-time remote Video & Photo Editor based in the Philippines to join our growing media team. This is a dual-skill role with two core focuses: cinematic real estate/architectural video editing and HDR post-processing of real estate/architectural photos. You’ll need demonstrated experience in both to be considered.



We’re looking for someone who is reliable, communicates well, works efficiently, takes pride in high-quality work, and is teachable and adaptable to feedback.



Responsibilities



•	Edit cinematic real estate and architectural videos — property tours, B-roll sequences, and money shots

•	Edit videos for social media, marketing, and promotional content

•	HDR post-processing of real estate/architectural photos with consistent quality and natural color

•	Deliver real estate photo edits within a 24-hour turnaround time

•	Organize project files and maintain efficient workflows

•	Collaborate on revisions and creative direction



Requirements



•	3+ years of experience in video editing

•	Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro

•	Experience editing cinematic real estate/architectural videos (B-roll sequencing, money shots, pacing)

•	Hands-on HDR post-processing experience with real estate/architectural photography (bracket merging, window pulls, natural color correction)

•	Strong attention to detail and organization

•	Strong English communication skills — comfortable with written feedback and live video calls

•	Able to work flexible hours, with working hours preferably falling within 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST (7:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila time)

•	Reliable internet connection and a computer setup that meets the requirements below



Computer & Internet Requirements



Your setup must comfortably run Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, and Photoshop, and render/export within reasonable times.



•	Processor: Intel Core i5 (10th gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better — or Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)

•	RAM: 16 GB minimum (32 GB recommended)

•	GPU: Dedicated graphics card with at least 4 GB VRAM (e.g., GTX 1650 or better)

•	Storage: SSD storage, 1 TB minimum (more preferred)

•	Internet: Stable fiber connection, 25 Mbps or faster (upload speed matters for file delivery); a backup connection is a plus



Preferred Skills



•	Knowledge of social media formatting and pacing (vertical video, hooks)

•	Experience with Adobe Lightroom or Adobe Photoshop

•	Basic motion graphics and color grading skills



Benefits



•	2 weeks paid vacation

•	3 paid sick days



Hiring Process



1.	Application and portfolio review

2.	15–20 minute phone/video screen (conducted in English)

3.	Short work-style survey

4.	Sample edit test using provided material

5.	Final video interview with our CEO



How to Apply



Include all of the following in your application. Applications missing any of these will not be considered:



1.	A link to your video editing reel or portfolio — cinematic real estate/architectural work strongly preferred

2.	Before/after samples of HDR real estate/architectural photos you personally edited

3.	A short description of your HDR post-processing workflow (software you use, how you merge brackets, how you handle window pulls)

4.	A short 3-minute Loom intro video answering this: “Tell us who you are and why you want this job.”

5.	Your computer specs (processor, RAM, GPU, storage) and internet connection details

6.	Confirmation that the listed rate works for you

title: Ads launcher (media buyer)
description:
We run a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand and launch new ad creatives every Tuesday and Wednesday. We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Ads Launcher to take ownership of this weekly process. This is a purely executional role, no strategy, no optimization, no media buying. We already have a media buying system in place. Your job is to launch the ads in the account flawlessly, every single week.



What you'll do:



- Upload and configure new ads in Meta Ads Manager so we have new ads live every thuesday and wednesday

- Follow our SOP step-by-step: media, primary text/headline, name of the ad

- Download assets from Google Drive and match them to the correct ad sets

- Double-check all copy, URLs, CTAs, and settings before publishing

- Send a launch confirmation (checklist or screenshot) after every session

- Flag any issues or discrepancies before they go live, never guess

Requirements

- Minimum 1 years of hands-on experience launching ads in Meta Ads Manager

- Proven track record working with e-commerce or DTC brands

- Understanding of Meta campaign structure (campaign ? ad set ? ad level)

- Exceptional attention to detail: errors in copy, links, or targeting are not acceptable





Include the following:



A short intro (3–5 sentences) explaining your experience launching Meta ads

2–3 examples of brands you've launched ads for (name + industry)

Your availability



?? Applications without all three items above will not be considered. We value precision, this starts here.

title: Real Estate Lead Generation VA | Base + Commission | Long-Term Role
description:
Top performers made $9,950 in a single quarter. Here's how.

The machine is already built. Active Meta ads are running. A fully loaded GoHighLevel CRM with scripts and objection handlers is ready to go. A live funnel with leads already coming in is waiting. All deal attribution is tracked with timestamps — no gray area, no guesswork.

Your job is to find qualified leads, book appointments, and work the system consistently. The pipeline is warm and you can be making calls in week one. Everything else is already in place.



About This Opportunity

Hi, I'm Jaz Sale — a licensed real estate agent based in Oklahoma City, active investor, and STR operator. I'm looking for a reliable, self-motivated Virtual Assistant to join my team long-term.

This is a pure outbound sales role. Your primary job is to find motivated sellers and qualified buyers through cold outreach — expired listings, FSBOs, circle prospecting, and direct cold calling — and book them as qualified appointments on my calendar.You will also follow up with warm inbound leads coming in from my social media and Meta ads.

But make no mistake — this role is built for someone who loves the hunt. If you're not comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day, this is not the right fit.



What a Qualified Lead Looks Like

A qualified lead is someone who has a real need — buying or selling in OKC in the next 30-90 days — has been contacted by you, is logged in GoHighLevel, and has agreed to a scheduled appointment with me.

You do not get credit for a name and number. You get credit for a booked, qualified conversation.



Compensation

Strong performers earned $9,950 in a single quarter. Here's the breakdown:

Example — Strong Quarter (8 deals at Tier 3):

8 × $800 = $6,400 + $1,500 quarterly bonus + $1,050 base = $9,950

Per-Deal Commission — Tiered by Performance:



Starter — Deal 1 — $400

Growing — Deals 2-5 — $650

Established — Deal 6+ — $800



Quarterly Production Bonuses:



Close 3 deals in a quarter  +$500

Close 5 deals in a quarter  +$1,000

Close 8+ deals in a quarter  +$1,500



Base Pay: $350/month

This is your runway while your pipeline builds — not your ceiling. The commission is where the real earning potential lives and it compounds fast once the pipeline is moving.



What You'll Be Doing



Prospect for motivated sellers daily — expired listings, FSBOs, circle prospecting, cold outreach

Generate and follow up with buyer leads across multiple channels

Follow up with warm inbound leads from social media and Meta ads

Qualify leads and book appointments directly on my calendar

Log all activity in GoHighLevel CRM — full training provided

Nurture cold leads until they are ready to move

Communicate professionally on behalf of my brand at all times

To apply — send a message through this platform with one sentence telling me why outbound sales is the right fit for you. If your background looks like a match I will reach out within 24 hours with next steps including a short video and application form. We respond fast to candidates who are serious





Activity Expectations

This role has a minimum daily floor — not a target, a floor.



First 30 days: 50+ outbound touches per day minimum while learning the scripts and system

After 30 days: 75+ daily touches minimum — every single day



Outbound touches include cold calls, texts, DMs, and
s combined. If you have done real outbound sales before this is completely normal. If this sounds like a lot this role probably is not the right fit.



Who We're Looking For



Experience in real estate lead gen, cold calling, or outbound sales — strongly preferred

Comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day without being asked

Self-directed — you manage your own time and hit your numbers without being chased

Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for calls

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience is a plus

Strong written and verbal English communication

Honest about what you know and hungry to learn what you don't





A Few Things to Know Upfront

Real estate deals take 30-60 days to close from when a lead is set. Strong performers typically see their first commission hit by week six — and the pipeline compounds from there. The base pay is your runway while that first cycle plays out. The people who stay consistent are the ones who see it pay off fast.

On the 1099 arrangement — this is an independent contractor role and that is intentional. 1099 means you control your schedule, your upside is completely uncapped, and there is no ceiling a W-2 would put on your earnings. The people who thrive here treat this like their own business — because it is.

Strong performers will be considered for expanded roles and higher earning potential over time. This is a long-term opportunity, not a short contract.



Important Details



Deal credit is clearly defined — you make first contact, log it in GoHighLevel, and book a qualified appointment that leads to a close. All tracked with timestamps. No gray area.

1099 independent contractor arrangement

You set your own schedule — we care about results, not hours

Scripts and objection handlers provided — you are not starting from scratch

Full GoHighLevel CRM training included





How to Apply — Two Steps, Both Required

We are reviewing the first 20 qualified applications. This posting comes down the moment we find the right candidate — not on a schedule. Don't wait.

Step 1: Record a 2-minute Loom video answering three things:



Who are you?

What is your sales or real estate experience?

Why is this role a good fit for you right now?



No scripts, no heavy editing — just talk directly. Paste your Loom link in your application.

Step 2: Complete our short 3-question application here: [INSERT TYPEFORM LINK]

Both steps are required. If you skip either one your application will not be reviewed.

After applying the next step is a short intro call with a live roleplay. Think of it as your audition for a spot on a winning team — not a test to screen you out. The candidates who lean into it are the ones who get hired. Come ready to pitch and we will respond fast.

title: Caregiver Recruiting, Onboarding & Front Office Support
description:
We are seeking an experienced virtual assistant to take ownership of caregiver recruiting, onboarding, and compliance, while also serving as a friendly, professional first point of contact for inbound calls from clients and caregivers. This is a part-time role with strong potential to grow as the business scales.



Schedule

• 20 hours per week to start

• Monday through Thursday

• 5 hours per day

• Must be available to work U.S. Central Time business hours

• Consistent, reliable daily attendance is required and the position requires 100?dication to that role during hours assigned



Primary Responsibilities



Caregiver Recruiting

• Manage the caregiver recruiting pipeline, including reviewing and screening incoming

applications against established hiring criteria (work history, relevant background,

required credentials)

• Verify applicant qualifications such as high school diploma and, for CNAs, a valid CNA

license

• Use a checklist-driven process to determine when candidates are ready to advance to

the next stage

• Work within an applicant tracking platform, Apploi, to move candidates through the

recruiting workflow, mark applicants ready for background checks, and trigger follow-ups

• Schedule interviews and coordinate candidate communication



Onboarding

• Handle the full onboarding process for new caregivers, including pre-hire and post-hire

paperwork

• Initiate and track background checks

• Collect and verify required documentation, including driver's license, auto insurance, and

other compliance items

• Transfer hired caregivers into payroll software

• Provision new caregiver accounts and access in the training platform

• Ensure all accounts are set up correctly and all documentation is filed in the right place



Compliance & Caregiver Retention

• Maintain ongoing compliance, including annual background checks and insurance

renewals

• Track caregiver certifications and qualifications to ensure they remain current

• Keep up with recurring compliance requirements and flag items that need attention



Front Office & Phone Support

• Answer inbound calls from clients and caregivers in a professional, courteous manner

• Conduct client intake and gather the right information to advance each inquiry to the next

step

• Know which calls to route and to whom, transferring callers appropriately

• Be knowledgeable about the agency's programs and services in order to speak

confidently with callers

• Provide general administrative assistant support, including managing schedules and

calendars and helping coordinate meetings



Required Qualifications

• Multiple years of caregiver recruiting experience

• Demonstrated experience with caregiver onboarding and compliance processes

• Strong phone skills with a clear, neutral accent

• Proven experience speaking with a U.S.-based client base, ideally within the healthcare

space

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple

workflows simultaneously

• Comfortable learning and working across multiple software platforms

• Reliable, self-directed, and able to work consistent scheduled hours independently

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills



Preferred Qualifications

• Caregiver recruiting experience specifically within the home care industry (strong plus)

• Familiarity with applicant tracking, payroll, and caregiver training platforms; experience

with Apploi is a plus

• Experience with both patient/client-facing intake and back-office administrative work



Tools & Systems

The role involves working within the agency's recruiting platform, payroll software, caregiver

training platform, and phone system. Prior experience with these specific tools is not required;

training will be provided, and the ability to quickly learn new systems is what matters most.

What Success Looks Like

This person will own the caregiver onboarding pipeline and serve as a dependable first line of

contact for clients and caregivers, freeing the owners to focus on growing the business.

Success will be measured against clear goals, such as a target number of caregivers

onboarded per pay period, alongside reliability, information retention, and the quality of client

and caregiver interactions.

title: Freight Disbatcher/Operations Manager
description:
We’re a growing U.S.-based truck dispatch company seeking a motivated Freight Dispatcher who can help find loads, negotiate rates, communicate with brokers, and assist with carrier acquisition.



Responsibilities:



* Find and book profitable freight using DAT, Truckstop, TruckSmarter, and other load boards

* Negotiate rates with freight brokers

* Dispatch and track trucks

* Minimize deadhead miles

* Maintain communication with drivers and brokers

* Assist with carrier onboarding

* Keep accurate records and update spreadsheets/CRM systems

* Help improve dispatch procedures and workflows

description:
What's Already Built and Running

Before you read anything else — here's what you're walking into:

A fully built GoHighLevel CRM with pipelines, automations, and lead tracking already live. An outbound cold caller generating expired listing and FSBO leads every single day. Active Meta ads generating inbound buyer and seller leads simultaneously. Scripts and follow-up templates ready to use from day one. Full attribution tracking with timestamps — no gray area on deal credit, ever.

The pipeline is being filled. I need someone sharp to work it.



Overview

I'm Jaz Sale — a licensed Oklahoma City real estate agent and active investor. I'm looking for a motivated Inside Sales Agent to take leads from first touch all the way to closed transaction.

Here's the division of labor: the cold caller finds them. You close them.

This is a commission-only role — flexible hours, results-based, and long term for the right person. If you're hungry, consistent, and know how to build relationships over weeks and months — this is a serious income opportunity.



What You'll Be Doing

Follow up with every inbound and outbound lead in GoHighLevel immediately — no lead sits untouched

Nurture cold leads through texts,
s, and social media DMs on a 30/60/90 day sequence

Confirm appointments and reduce no-shows before every consultation

Re-engage dead or unresponsive leads in the pipeline

Manage the full pipeline in GHL — every lead has a status, every lead gets a touchpoint

Communicate professionally with buyers and sellers on behalf of Jaz Sale

Send a daily pipeline update — leads contacted, responses received, appointments confirmed

Work closely with the outbound cold caller to ensure warm leads are followed up on immediately

Minimum daily activity floor: 75 lead touchpoints per day across calls, texts,
s, and DMs combined.

Consistent daily reporting is non-negotiable — this is how we track your earnings and protect your deal credit.



Communication Channels

GoHighLevel CRM — texts and
s with templates provided

Social media DMs —
 and Instagram

Phone calls for warm leads and appointment confirmations



Commission Structure

Commission-only. You earn when deals close. Here's the floor — no ceiling on performance:

Closed buyer transaction originating from your pipeline — 3% of gross commission earned

Closed seller listing transaction originating from your pipeline — 2.5% of gross commission earned

Qualified appointment that shows and converts to a consultation — $25 bonus per appointment

What the math looks like:

Standard close — OKC buyer transaction at $6,000 gross commission = $180 for the ISA. Strong close — OKC buyer transaction at $15,000 gross commission = $450 for the ISA. 5 closes in a month at the standard floor = $900 in transaction commission. Add 10 qualified appointments at $25 each and your realistic floor month is $1,150 — while your pipeline is still building.

OKC average transaction values are climbing — the floor is the minimum, not the typical. There is no ceiling on what this looks like as the pipeline grows and your volume increases.



Who We're Looking For

You're the right fit if:

You have experience in real estate, inside sales, or lead nurturing

Your written and spoken English is clear and professional

You're self-motivated — you don't need to be chased for daily updates

You understand that commission-only means consistency is everything

You're comfortable with GoHighLevel or willing to learn it fast

You're relationship-driven — you know how to keep leads warm over weeks and months

You're based in the Philippines and available during US business hours CST

You're NOT the right fit if:

You've never done sales or lead follow-up before

You need a guaranteed salary to stay motivated

You go quiet when leads don't respond immediately

THE ROLE

title: Full Time Dispatcher
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Dispatcher with a positive attitude and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will have expertise in load negotiation, scheduling, and route planning, while adhering to DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched



26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans / Cargo Vans / Ram ProMaster (High Roof)



About Us



Eveready Express is a well-established leader in the trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution industries, founded in 1984. We pride ourselves on honesty, integrity, and mutual respect.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatching Vehicles



Negotiate rates with drivers while aiming for a minimum 40% margin, and assign vehicles to specific routes and deliveries based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.



Communication with Drivers



Maintain constant communication with drivers by providing instructions, updates, and support throughout their routes.



Routing and Scheduling



Plan efficient routes to minimize travel time, fuel costs, and vehicle wear. Adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or unexpected events.



Tracking Shipments



Monitor shipments in real time using tracking systems and GPS technology. Address delays or issues as they arise.



Customer Interaction



Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch, providing delivery updates, addressing inquiries, and resolving concerns or complaints promptly.



Documentation



Maintain accurate records of trucking activities, including driver logs, delivery schedules, and customer communications. Ensure compliance with company policies and regulations (e.g., BOL, POD).



Problem-Solving



Resolve logistical problems or emergencies such as vehicle breakdowns, traffic delays, or adverse weather conditions.



Safety Compliance



Ensure trucks and drivers comply with safety regulations and company policies. Regularly verify driver credentials, vehicle maintenance, and adherence to transportation laws in collaboration with HR.



Team Collaboration



Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet Drivers, Billing, Sales, HR, and Warehouse staff to coordinate operations and improve efficiency.



Continuous Improvement



Identify and suggest improvements to dispatching processes, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Offer feedback and innovative solutions to the management team.



Working on Load Boards



Bid on Sylectus, DAT, Amazon Relay, and other broker platforms during the off-peak season.



Qualifications



• At least 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics industry, with proven experience in dispatching, logistics coordination, or transportation management.



• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with drivers, customers, and tea
mbers.



• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.



• Proficiency in dispatching software, GPS systems, and other relevant technology tools.



• Knowledge of transportation regulations, safety procedures, and industry best practices.



• Ability to remain calm under pressure, with a problem-solving mindset and flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances.



• Availability to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure 24/7 coverage.



Hardware & Technical Requirements



• Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 preferred)

• RAM: Minimum 8 GB

• Disk Space: 100 GB of free space

• A second monitor for multitasking

• Backup computer

• Noise-canceling headset

• Internet: Minimum 20  Mbps wired connection for both primary and backup ISPs

• USB sticks are not allowed for backup ISP connections



Perks of the Job



• Competitive weekly salary

• Opportunity to receive HMO benefits

• Opportunities for advancement within the company



To Apply



Please send an
 with the subject line:



“I want to dispatch for Eveready”



to 



Your
 must include:



• A voice recording (via Speakpipe or Vocaroo) explaining why you are a good fit for the role

• A PDF copy of your resume

• A photo of your workstation

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



Please follow all instructions above. Only applicants who demonstrate genuine interest in the role will be considered.



If selected, you will be invited to a brief
 or Google Meet interview, which will require a video call.



Equal Opportunity Employer



Eveready Express is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy), age, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.



We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.



Note



Eveready Express reserves the right to modify job duties and assignments at any time. The job description provided is not all-encompassing and may change depending on business needs.

title: Amazon SPP Lead
description:
About us:

At Seller Candy, our vision is to give balance, certainty & peace of mind to e-commerce entrepreneurs. We’re a value-driven company that believes our team is as important as our customers. Our core values are; Own-it, Authenticity, Determination, Expertise, and Impact through Growth. 

To accomplish our vision we remove the daily friction experienced by e-commerce entrepreneurs by handling their Amazon account issues and support cases with agency-level expertise and best practices in a fun and collaborative environment. 



Seller Candy bridges the gap from “online seller” to business owner. We enable millions of dollars in revenue and free hundreds of people from their jobs, transforming them into confident entrepreneurs accomplishing their dreams. 



Seller Candy is in an exciting phase of growth so join us and imagine yourself being part of changing lives!





About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Amazon PPC Lead to oversee and manage advertising performance across multiple Amazon brands. This role is ideal for a highly analytical and client-facing advertising professional who can develop strategies, optimize campaigns, communicate with clients, and collaborate with leadership teams to drive growth.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Director of Operations, Team Leads, and Leadership Team while preparing for future leadership opportunities within the organization.



What you will do:



Key Responsibilities



Amazon Advertising Management

Manage and optimize Amazon advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts simultaneously.

Build, launch, and scale:

     1. Sponsored Products (SP)

     2. Sponsored Brands (SB)

     3. Sponsored Brands Video (SBV)

Develop account-specific PPC strategies aligned with business goals and profitability targets.

Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience targeting.

Manage campaign structures, budgets, bids, placements, and targeting strategies.

Monitor and improve key performance metrics including:

     1. ACOS

     2. TACOS

     3. ROAS

     4. CPC

     5. CTR

     6. Conversion Rate

     7. New-to-Brand Metrics

Execute testing strategies for:

     1. Keywords

     2. Product targeting

     3. Audience targeting

     4. Bid strategies

     5. Creative assets



PPC Audits & Strategic Planning

Conduct comprehensive Amazon advertising audits.

Identify growth opportunities and inefficiencies.

Develop actionable optimization roadmaps.

Create launch strategies for new products and brands.

Build scaling plans for mature accounts.

Stay updated on Amazon Advertising platform changes and emerging strategies.



Client Management

Attend client calls and strategy meetings.

Present performance reports and recommendations confidently.

Explain advertising concepts in a clear, professional manner.

Build trust and maintain strong client relationships.

Handle client questions, concerns, and strategic discussions.



Leadership & Collaboration

Collaborate with the Director of Operations and Team Leads on account strategy.

Work cross-functionally with account managers, catalog specialists, creatives, and operations teams.

Assist in mentoring junior PPC specialists.

Contribute to process improvements and best practices.

Demonstrate readiness to take on a future Team Lead or Leadership position.



Reporting & Analysis

Analyze account performance and identify trends.

Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.

Forecast advertising spend and sales performance.

Provide data-driven recommendations for account growth.



Required Qualifications

Amazon PPC Experience

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC management experience.

Proven experience managing multiple Amazon brands simultaneously.

Strong experience with:

     1. Sponsored Products (SP)

     2. Sponsored Brands (SB)

     3. Sponsored Brands Video (SBV)

Experience managing monthly advertising budgets exceeding $20,000+ preferred.

Experience with product launches and account scaling.



Technical Skills

Advanced understanding of:

     1. Keyword harvesting

     2. Search term optimization

     3. Bid optimization

     4. Placement optimization

     5. Dayparting strategies

     6. Product targeting

     7. Audience targeting

Strong understanding of:

     1. ACOS

     2. TACOS

     3. ROAS

     4. Incrementality

     5. Brand growth metrics

Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

Experience using PPC software is a plus:

     1. Helium 10

     2. Data Dive

     3. Perpetua

     4. Pacvue

     5. Quartile

     6. Scale Insights

     7. Sellerboard



Communication & Leadership Requirements

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Comfortable speaking directly with clients.

Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Able to communicate complex advertising strategies in simple terms.

Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Demonstrates leadership potential and readiness for future management responsibilities.

Comfortable working with senior leadership and participating in strategic discussions.



Proof of Experience Required

Applicants must provide at least three (3) of the following:

Amazon PPC case studies showing measurable results.

Before-and-after account performance examples.

Screenshots of campaign structures managed.

Advertising reports demonstrating account growth.

Examples of successful product launches.

Examples of PPC audits conducted.

Client testimonials or references.

Video walkthrough of a campaign optimization process.

Portfolio detailing brands and advertising budgets managed.



Preferred Experience

Experience working in an Amazon agency environment.

Experience managing 5+ Amazon brands simultaneously.

Experience with Amazon DSP (preferred but not required).

Experience working with six-figure and seven-figure Amazon sellers.

Experience leading or mentoring PPC tea
mbers.

Familiarity with Amazon attribution, AMC, and advanced advertising strategies.



What Seller Candy Is Looking For

Strategic thinker who stays current with the latest Amazon advertising updates and best practices.

Strong client-facing professional capable of owning account strategy discussions.

Data-driven decision maker who can identify opportunities quickly.

Team player who collaborates effectively with Operations, Team Leads, and Leadership.

Future leader who can grow into a PPC Manager or Team Lead role.

Someone who takes ownership, drives results, and continuously seeks ways to improve client performance.

Starting Salary: $1000/mo

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, weekends subject to arrangement if needed

Onboarding Date: July

title: Marketing Operations Assistant
description:
We’re a U.S.-based B2B software company in the energy space, and we’re looking for a marketing operations specialist who loves data as much as marketing execution.



You’ll work closely with our Sales & Marketing Department to bring campaigns to life—not by creating content, but by making sure everything behind the scenes runs smoothly. This role is all about turning strategy into execution inside HubSpot.



If you enjoy organizing messy data, building smart workflows, and making sure the right message reaches the right audience, this role is for you.





What You’ll Do



Own Our HubSpot CRM

- Clean and organize contact and company data (duplicates, errors, lifecycle stages) 

- Build and manage lists, properties, and segmentation 

- Keep our CRM accurate, structured, and easy to use 

- Continuously improve data quality using tools like 
 and NeverBounce 



Power Our Marketing Campaigns

- Set up and execute
 campaigns, workflows, and automation in HubSpot 

- Build nurture sequences, follow-ups, and lead routing 

- Support full campaign lifecycle execution—from audience segmentation to launch and follow-up 

- Coordinate
 campaigns with LinkedIn outreach and targeting efforts 

- Ensure campaigns are reaching the right people at the right time  



Make Our Systems Work Together

- Help connect HubSpot with internal tools and data sources 

- Ensure clean data flow across systems so campaigns can be executed quickly and easily 



Manage Leads & Data Quality

- Review inbound leads and ensure proper routing 

- Support lead scoring improvements 

- Identify and clean low-quality or invalid data 



Track & Improve Performance

- Pull and prepare campaign reports 

- Monitor for issues (broken workflows, missing data, inconsistencies) 

- Help us continuously improve how we use HubSpot





What Success Looks Like

- HubSpot is clean, organized, and reliable 

- Campaigns launch smoothly and on time 

- Data flows seamlessly between systems 

- Marketing campaigns are well-targeted and coordinated across channels 
 + LinkedIn) 

- The sales and marketing team can execute quickly without manual work slowing things down 

- You take direction and turn it into completed, high-quality execution





Requirements

- 2+ years experience with HubSpot 

- Experience in marketing operations, automation, and CRM management 

- Strong attention to detail and organization 

- Strong written English 

- Ability to work independently and follow through on tasks 





Who This Role Is Perfect For

- You enjoy working behind the scenes to make marketing run smoothly 

- You like structure, systems, and clean data 

- You understand how campaigns move from idea ? execution ? follow-up 

- You’re a “HubSpot power user” or want to become one  

- You enjoy execution more than strategy or content creation





HOW TO APPLY

We receive a high volume of applications. We only review candidates who follow instructions exactly.



Step 1: Subject Line

Use ONE of the following Enerex core values as your subject line:

- Earn Trust 

- We > Me 

- Own It 

- Create Simplicity 

- Celebrate Progress 



If your subject line does not match one of these exactly, your application will not be reviewed.



Step 2: Explain Your Choice + Answer Questions

Answer these questions in the body of your
:

- Which value did you choose, and why does it resonate most with you? Use a real example.

- Give an example of how you improved or simplified a process. 

- What actions do you take to build trust with a remote manager? 



BONUS POINTS (not required but definitely merits plus points): Record a Loom video explaining why this role is a good fit for you..

title: Customer Success Project Manager
description:

This role is part of the Customer Success team and will work closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Sales, and Development teams to ensure onboarding projects move smoothly and efficiently. While the role is primarily internal-facing, occasional customer communication may be required during onboarding and implementation processes.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple moving parts in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.





Key Responsibilities



Customer Onboarding & Implementation

- Coordinate onboarding and implementation activities across internal teams 

- Track onboarding timelines, tasks, deliverables, and follow-ups 

- Support smooth handoff from Sales to Customer Success 

- Work closely with CSMs to ensure onboarding requirements are completed 

- Coordinate onboarding-related requests and configurations with Development teams 

- Monitor project progress and escalate blockers or delays when needed 



Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as a key coordinator between Customer Success, Sales, and Development teams 

- Organize meetings, action items, and internal follow-ups 

- Help prioritize onboarding and implementation-related requests 

- Maintain visibility into onboarding status and team responsibilities 

- Support alignment across departments during onboarding projects 



Customer Success Support

- Support CSMs during onboarding and implementation processes 

- Assist with onboarding documentation and customer tracking 

- Help ensure customers have a smooth onboarding experience 

- Occasionally communicate with customers regarding onboarding updates or requirements 



Process Documentation & Improvement

- Document current workflows and operational processes 

- Create and maintain SOPs, onboarding guides, and internal documentation 

- Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and communication issues 

- Recommend and implement workflow improvements 

- Help standardize onboarding and coordination processes across teams 

- Support scalable operational improvements as the company grows 





Qualifications

- 2–5 years of experience in Project Coordination, Customer Success, Operations, or Implementation roles 

- Experience working in a B2B SaaS environment 

- Strong organizational and communication skills 

- Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders 

- Comfortable working with cross-functional teams 

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through 

- Familiarity with CRM and project management tools is a plus





About Enerex

Enerex provides technology solutions for the energy industry through products including MarketHub, BrokerHub, DataHub, and SupplierHub. Our mission is to simplify operations, improve visibility, and enable growth for energy suppliers, brokers, and partners through modern SaaS platforms.





APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit your resume along with a short introduction about your background and experience.



Please also review Enerex’s Core Values (check our website) and include which core value resonates with you the most and why. Use the core value you selected as the subject line of your application.



Please also answer this question in writing:

Describe a time when you had to coordinate between multiple teams or stakeholders to complete a project or task. How did you keep everything organized?

title: Photo Editor
description:

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor (eCommerce) — ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling | Long-Term
description:
HIRING: AI Video Editor — Pet Brand / Full-Time, Remote

We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the pet space. We sell health and grooming products for dogs, and paid social is our primary growth channel. That means creative isn't just "content" for us — it's one of the main drivers of the business.

We are not looking for a freelancer. We want someone who wants to immerse themselves in what we do, understand our customer, our product, our creative angles — and become part of the team long-term. If we grow, you grow with us.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

— Edit performance ads for Meta (UGC-style, talking-head, product demo, testimonial, VSL)

— Work from scripts and briefs we provide — sometimes variants of a winner, sometimes from scratch

— Source B-roll, stock footage, and references that match the script and angle

— Use AI tools heavily in your workflow: voiceovers, AI actors, generative B-roll, captions, upscaling

— Add captions, motion graphics, sound design, hooks, pattern interrupts

— Deliver as many concepts as possible per week while maintaining quality standard



YOU UNDERSTAND MARKETING, NOT JUST EDITING

You don't need to be a media buyer. But you need to understand the fundamentals — because a good edit starts with understanding who we're talking to and why.

We'll brief you fully on:

— Our target customer (who they are, what they struggle with, what they want)

— What our product does and the angles we lead with

— The hook, the promise, and the emotional beat each ad is supposed to land

Your job is to internalize all of that and edit toward it — not just cut clips together.



AI IS PART OF THE JOB

This is non-negotiable. You should already be using tools like:

— Kling, Higgsfield, Sora, Google Veo — for generative B-roll

— HeyGen, Arcads — for AI actors and UGC-style talking heads

— ElevenLabs or similar — for voiceovers

— Captioning, upscaling, and AI enhancement tools

If you don't already use these daily, this role isn't for you.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

— Proactive. We don't want to chase you. If a script is unclear, ask. If you see a better angle, suggest it. If B-roll doesn't exist, find it or generate it

— You think with us. You understand what the script is trying to do and edit toward that goal

— Sharp eye. Pacing, music choice, captions, hook strength — all tight

— You respect deadlines and respond in a reasonable time

— You're looking for an ongoing collaboration, not a one-off job

— Fluent in written and spoken English



WHO WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

If you only do cinematic, wedding, or YouTube editing — this isn't for you.

If you've never used AI generation tools — this isn't for you.

If you need to be told what to do at every step — this isn't for you.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

— Minimum 1 year of experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

— Portfolio with real
/Meta ad examples

— Experience with AI tools (specify which ones and how you use them)

— Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar

— Bonus if you've worked in the pet space or with animal product brands



DAY TO DAY

— Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

— Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

— Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

— Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

— Collaborating with the team to improve performance

— Using feedback from results to make stronger iterations



GROWTH & BENEFITS

— All tools, courses, and subscriptions covered by us

— Clear growth path: Editor ? Senior Editor ? Head of Creative

— Long-term position with a brand that's scaling aggressively



COMPENSATION

Competitive salary based on experience, paid monthly in USD.



HOW TO APPLY

Interested? Send me a message to move to the next step. Start your message with the word PAWS — applications without it will be ignored.

description:
About the Role



Fleetmule is a fast-growing startup helping small and mid-sized trucking companies stay compliant with FMCSA and DOT safety requirements using AI, automation, and hands-on compliance support.



We are looking for a Social Media Growth Operator / Content Creator to help us become the most visible AI trucking safety brand online.



This is not a “make pretty graphics” role.



We need someone who can create short-form videos, write strong hooks, actively comment on trucking-related conversations, engage with carriers, dispatchers, owner-operators, and safety managers, and help turn social media attention into real leads.



The right person may also become the face of the brand on video — recording talking-head clips, reacting to trucking safety issues, explaining DOT/FMCSA problems in simple language, and creating content that feels real, useful, and direct.



What You’ll Do



You will own day-to-day social media activity across platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and
.



Responsibilities include:



Create short-form video ideas, scripts, hooks, captions, and posts

Record talking-head videos yourself when needed

Edit or coordinate simple video edits with subtitles, B-roll, screenshots, and trucking-related visuals

Comment daily on trucking, DOT, FMCSA, compliance, safety, freight, dispatch, and owner-operator content

Engage with trucking communities, pages, groups, creators, and prospects

Turn Fleetmule’s expertise into educational, viral, and lead-generating content

Respond to comments and DMs using approved scripts

Track which posts, hooks, comments, and topics generate attention and leads

Help build a repeatable weekly content system



Examples of Content Topics



“Your DOT audit problem probably started 6 months ago”

“The hidden cost of bad driver qualification files”

“What owner-operators get wrong about safety compliance”

“AI tools for trucking compliance and safety”

“Real stories from carriers who ignored safety problems too long”



Who We’re Looking For



You should be someone who is comfortable being active online every day. You do not need to know everything about trucking on day one, but you must be willing to learn fast.



Ideal candidate:



Strong short-form video instincts

Comfortable on camera or willing to become comfortable

Excellent written English

Understands TikTok/Reels/Shorts style content

Knows how to write strong hooks and captions

Can comment naturally without sounding like spam

Can research trucking industry topics

Has good judgment and can represent a serious B2B brand

Bonus Points



Experience with trucking, logistics, freight, dispatch, safety, DOT, FMCSA, or compliance

Experience growing B2B social media accounts

Experience creating founder-led or face-of-brand content

Experience with CapCut, Canva, Descript, Premiere, or similar tools

Experience with LinkedIn growth,
/X, Reddit,
 Groups, or TikTok community engagement

Experience turning comments and DMs into leads



What Success Looks Like



In the first 30–60 days, success means:



3–5 short-form videos published per week

Daily comments on relevant trucking conversations

More profile visits, followers, comments, and DMs

Clear testing of different hooks and topics

A repeatable content calendar

Qualified trucking leads coming from social media activity



Important



We are not looking for someone who only schedules posts.



We are looking for someone who can help us create attention, trust, and conversations in the trucking industry.



You should be comfortable with fast testing, direct feedback, and taking ownership of growth.

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), as well as the ability to follow instructions clearly and reliably, are absolutely essential for this role. These are critical to maintaining efficient workflows in our entirely remote structure.

s professionally and manage shared inboxes

• Excellent English skills – fluent in both written and spoken communication is non-negotiable

s may come through. In such cases, a simple response to confirm receipt and intended follow-up (e.g. on Monday) is appreciated.
